text: Steel for sale! Cutlasses, rapiers, daggers, axes.
{npc}, armorer. You want something sharp, or something to stop something sharp?
Mind the grindstone. It's hungry.
Keep your voice down. There are marines about, and your face is on the posters.
I'll serve you, but quickly. Bounty hunters drink in here.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Tell me about the legendary blades.

text: Cutlass for a brawl, rapier for a duel, dagger for the dark, boarding axe for the door.
Most captains carry two. The smart ones carry three.
Whetstone in one hand, blade in the other. Better smiths can take it further: up to the third edge, if you've the skill.
Every dungeon vault has something old and sharp in it. Some of those blades have names. Some of them have tempers.
